Search Options: General Search Options・AND Search (including multiple words [delimiter:blank] at the same time) ex.A B → A B,AB,AcB,…・OR  Search (including multiple words [delimiter:blank])        ex.A B → A,B,Ac,cB,A B,AB,AcB,…・Partial Match (with start digit) ex, 34 from dig.5: JP1234,112234 / 123 from dig.3: JP1234,001234・Perfect Match ex.AB → AB only (×: aB, 0AB, ABAB,…)・Start with    ex.A → A,AB,AcB,A000,A12,A_0,… (×:aAB,0AB,_AB,…)・End   with    ex.A → A,BA,BcA,000A,12A,0_A,… (×:aAB,B0A,A_B,…)Regular Expression: Specify the format, such as serial, in detail　\d{10} :10-digit number                 ex.1234567890,0987654321　7\d{9} :10-digit number starting with 7 ex.7123456789　\d{3,5}:3-5 digit number                ex.123,4567,89012,… (×:12,ABC,123456,…)　\w{5}  :5-digit alphabet/_/number[a-zA-Z_0-9](hereinafter referred to as letter)　\w{3}-\d{4}:3-digit letter + hyphen + 4-digit number                  ex.AB3-1234　JP\d{10}    :12-digit number starting with JP (DNJP part number, etc.) ex.JP1234567890　(JP|EN)\d{2}:4-digit character starting with JP or EN                  ex.JP12,EN34

Window length Hover AgP:
Enter the time width for calculating one plot or summary result. Please enter a number between 0.01 (=36 seconds) and less than 20,000 (=833 days). If it is equal to the interval, evaluate all data without overlap (recommended setting). If it is larger than the interval, data overlap will occur (effective when there is little data. However, since some of the same data is evaluated, there is a concern that changes may become slow). If the value is smaller than the interval, data will not overlap and some data will not be evaluated (effective when there is a large number of data. However, not recommended as some data will not be evaluated). 
e.g.) 1 week = 168h, 30 days = 720h, a half year = 4320h, one year = 8760h

ProcessConfigFilterHover:
Data will be imported based on the values entered here. Regular expressions can be used.
For example, use
""   “abc” to search for items containing “abc” (partial match),
   “^abc” to find items starting with “abc”,
   “^abc$” for items matching “abc” (exact match),
   “ab|c” to search for items containing either “ab” or “c” (OR condition), and
   “^(?!test|abc).*” to find items starting something other than “test” or “abc”.
(“^” indicates that the next character is at the beginning, “$” indicates that the preceding character is at the end, and “|” means OR.
Note: The quotation marks are not needed when entering the values.)

Waveform Plot Description:
You can visualize waveforms for each cycle.
Multiple waveforms can be plotted on a single graph, and coloring is also supported.
For example, by comparing press‑fit waveforms, current waveforms,
or vibration waveforms of good and defective products,
you can identify rising‑edge changes in specific sections or detect variations in peak positions.
WfP Display variable hover:
Select two variables: the x‑value and y‑value of the waveforms. The first selected variable becomes the x‑axis.
Selecting a 'Div' variable (used to group identical waveforms, such as Cycle ID) is mandatory.

ImportLimitTitle:
Limits the number of rows to import.
The limit applies to each process (e.g., for a database: table, for CSV: folder).
If you decrease the limit or when importing the latest data, if the number of rows exceeds the limit,
the oldest data will be deleted from database in AP+DN7.
When the import limit is increased, the data previously imported into AP+DN7 is first deleted and then re-imported from the data sources.
